paragraphs: The 425d and 430d are effectively the same engine under two different badges — both use the B47, BMW's second-generation 2.0-litre four-cylinder diesel. Introduced in 2015 as a replacement for the N47, the B47 was fitted to the F32/F33/F36 generation 4 Series from 2015 onward, with earlier cars using the older N47 unit. The B47 is a significantly more reliable engine than its predecessor, addressing the timing chain issues that plagued the N47. The 425d/430d was discontinued in 2020 when the 4 Series moved to the G22 generation — but we continue to rebuild and replace engines for every one still on the road.
about.boldParagraph: The 425d is no longer in production, but we continue to rebuild and replace engines for every one still on the road.
